_note: Rough, uncalibrated check - NOT audiometry. Tones are kept quiet (amplitudeDb below full scale) with soft fades, and stored as uncompressed WAV because low-bitrate MP3 removes the high frequencies. side: 0 = both ears (mono), 1 = left only, 2 = right only (stereo with the other channel silent).

English._warning: Turn the volume down and put on headphones before starting. This is not a medical hearing test.
